note: Before the layout move (STRUCTURE.md 7) each Act of Parliament had a folder at the top of the repository named by its short title without the year; paths maps each old folder to its folder under central/acts/, and files maps every file. constitution/ did not move. The move changed no file's content, so git log --follow and git blame follow it; tools/on.py reads an act under any of its names. data/versions.json, data/laws.csv and data/parts.json keep the old folder names (the build corpus keys of the first versions).
